faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Puntr is a place to post sports predictions that are locked at kick-off, graded automatically and kept as a public record, so you can build a track record people can trust.
faq.a2: PuntPoints are leaderboard points for activity and settled picks. They have no cash value and cannot be exchanged for money.
faq.a3: Yes. Members get a personal invite link. We record who invited whom, and there are no payments for referrals.
faq.a4: Yes. Puntr is free during the Founding 100 launch. Any paid features later will be announced first and never switched on without notice.
faq.a5: Every tipster has a public record with units, ROI and sample size. Past results do not predict future results. Gamble responsibly: 0800 006 008.
faq.a6: No. PuntPoints have no monetary value and cannot be withdrawn or exchanged for cash.
faq.a7: No. Puntr does not accept bets, set odds or handle winnings. It is a place to record and review predictions.
